knowledge.title: Trusted Knowledge Sources
knowledge.intro: Aaghosh AI's coaching responses are grounded exclusively in the following authoritative sources. The AI never fabricates guidance — every recommendation is drawn directly from these documents.
knowledge.publisherName: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC)
knowledge.publisherDescription: The CDC is the primary publisher of the knowledge base used by Aaghosh AI. It offers extensive, structured guidance on child development covering every age band from infancy through middle childhood.
knowledge.step1.title: Careful Reading
knowledge.step1.desc: Official CDC documents are broken into short, meaningful sections — each one a single tip or milestone.
knowledge.step2.title: Organised Library
knowledge.step2.desc: Every section is filed with its source, age band, and topic so the right guidance can be found quickly.
knowledge.step3.title: Finding What Fits
knowledge.step3.desc: When you ask a question, the sections closest to your situation and your child's age are selected.
knowledge.step4.title: Grounded Answers
knowledge.step4.desc: The AI Coach builds its answer using only those selected sections, and lists them so you can check the source.
knowledge.sources.stacks.title: CDC Stacks — Digital Publication Repository
knowledge.sources.stacks.description: A free, open-access library of CDC publications, including developmental milestone checklists and programme reports.
knowledge.sources.stacks.highlight2: Covers cognitive, social, emotional, and physical milestones
knowledge.sources.stacks.highlight3: Kept up to date with current CDC recommendations
knowledge.sources.stacks.highlight4: Free and open to the public
knowledge.sources.positive.title: Positive Parenting Tips — Age-Band Guidelines
knowledge.sources.positive.description: Detailed, age-banded parenting guidance for infants (0–1), toddlers (1–3), preschoolers (3–5), middle childhood (6–8), and older age groups. This is the main source behind the AI Coach's answers.
knowledge.sources.positive.highlight2: Covers emotional regulation, social skills, communication, and learning
knowledge.sources.positive.highlight3: Practical, parent-friendly suggestions you can try at home
knowledge.sources.positive.highlight4: Cited directly in AI Coach responses
knowledge.sources.signs.title: "Learn the Signs. Act Early." Program
knowledge.sources.signs.description: A CDC public health programme offering developmental milestones and practical advice for tracking your child's growth, covering checkpoints at 2, 4, 6, 9, 12, 15, 18, 24, and 30 months and 2–5 years.
knowledge.sources.signs.highlight1: Milestone checklists for each age checkpoint
knowledge.sources.signs.highlight2: Clear guidance on what to expect at each stage
knowledge.sources.signs.highlight4: Organised by age and developmental area
knowledge.disclaimerPart1: Aaghosh AI uses these sources to provide evidence-informed
knowledge.disclaimerPart3: and cannot replace a licensed psychologist, paediatrician, or healthcare professional. All AI responses cite the specific source they are drawn from.
